retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast black and white portrait featuring a male subject with textured hair, framed by wide-tracked, extended serif typography at the top and bottom margins.
triggerTerms: high contrast portrait with wide tracking
excludeWhen: landscape photography is the primary focus

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, high-contrast monochrome portrait of a male subject looking downward, characterized by soft lighting on the face and deep shadows in the hair. The composition is anchored by two horizontal bands of text: a bold, extended serif at the top and a light, widely-spaced serif at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Text framing the subject at extreme top and bottom margins
High contrast between the white background and dark hair/shadows
Diagonal movement created by the subject's head tilt and hand placement
Balance between heavy display type and delicate body type

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered close-up portrait, filling approximately 80% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and hand, positioned in the center-right of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold top text, follows the downward gaze of the subject, and rests on the bottom text line.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: High-key white space surrounding the subject's shoulders and the left side of the frame.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and charcoal shadows in hair and clothing
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Dark teal or forest green for the primary display text
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with very low saturation, bordering on grayscale.
paletteRestrictions: Single dark accent color for text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extended slab-serif and classical roman serif
letterConstructionRules: Top text uses ultra-extended horizontal proportions
Bottom text uses standard proportions with extreme tracking
Heavy weight for the top display, light weight for the bottom metadata
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between heavy horizontal expansion and light vertical elegance.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the horizontal stretch and bold presence of the top text.
Provides the classical, light serif feel for the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white portrait of a man with textured, medium-length hair, looking down with his hand near his temple, against a clean white background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of bold, ultra-extended serif text at the top margin and a single line of light, extremely wide-tracked serif text at the bottom margin.

verificationChecks: Is the top text significantly wider than it is tall?
Is the bottom text tracking wide enough to span the full width?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
postGenerationChecks: Check for clarity of the extended serif letterforms
Ensure the bottom text is legible despite extreme tracking
Verify the monochrome balance avoids muddy grays
Confirm the subject's pose conveys the intended melancholic mood
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast monochrome portrait + Extended bold serif top + Wide-tracked light serif bottom.
